firstFailureBoundary.observation: After the command helper returned, the generic quick-input locator remained hidden for 30 seconds before the stale file path could be filled.

dependentFailure.observation: The stale-refusal alert never appeared because the preceding stale-file interaction was not completed.

relevantSynchronization.observation: The extension appends its action log before showing the warning and posting the webview reply. The host test waits on this log before issuing its next command; that log is not an acknowledgement that host UI work has settled.

limitations: No failure screenshot or trace is captured for the quick-input helper.
The logs do not distinguish an undelivered palette command from a file dialog that opened then closed.
The desktop-clear rerun reproduced the failure, so concurrent PowerPoint is not established as the cause.
Only LICENSE line-ending bytes changed between the previously passing and canonical VSIX; executable members are identical, but the earlier passing installed receipt is not transferred.
suggestedFollowup: Capture command-palette selection and file-picker acknowledgement at the failure, then synchronize the unchanged stale/refusal journey with the exact file-picker UI. Determine the cause before proposing a code fix; do not weaken assertions or merely raise timeouts.
